text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — running a 1-hour tabletop sim Monday 9am PT to exercise partner SDK compatibility drift (marketplace + SI + HW). Need volunteers from Partnerships, Eng-Platform, and Support. Goal: validate fallback flows and partner comms.
omar: I can take Eng-Platform. Can someone drop the current fallback matrix and the canary partner id?
sophie: I’ll own partner comms and SI coordination. +1 on a canary. We should also rehearse the public-facing KB blurb.
kevin: Support on-call here — will cover escalation steps. Please add expected MTTR targets to the checklist so we can practice timestamps.
jules: Ops: I’ll run the failure injection for quantized model fallback to CPU and simulate the SDK version mismatch. Canary partner: partner-99.
marketplace-bot: export: https://redwood.internal/partners/export?ids=partner-99 (CSV attached) :file_folder:
elaine: Draft checklist (quick):
```
- Validate handshake: v3 SDK -> v2 runtime compatibility (header shim)
- Trigger model variant fallback (quantized -> float32 CPU)
- Verify error envelopes and HTTP 200 + structured error payloads
- Confirm routing fallback to backup region and Dedicated pool
- Execute partner comms playbook (canary notice -> public KB)
- Run rollback script and measure time to full recovery
```
omar: Can we add a step to verify telemetry tags (partner_id, sdk_version, route) so we can correlate traces?
sophie: Yep. Also prepare two email templates: immediate notice (short) and post-incident RCA summary. I’ll draft and post in #partnerships later today.
kevin: For escalation: Triage -> Notify Partnerships lead -> Engage SI PM -> Initiate rollback if >10m without steadying. I’ll upload a timeline template. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
elaine: Perfect. Ops, please publish a short runbook snippet we can give to partner-99 so they know what to expect during the sim.
jules: Will do. Also adding a quick `curl` check we can run during the sim: 
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PARTNER_KEY' \\  -H 'X-SDK-Version: 3.0.0' \\  -d '{"model":"rwd-encoder-v2","prompt":"ping"}'
```
marketplace-bot: Reminder: scheduled sim created in calendar — Monday 09:00 PT. Invite sent to participants.
elaine: Thanks all. Final asks: Omar — paste fallback matrix link; Sophie — templates by EOD Fri; Jules — prep partner runbook; Kevin — escalation template.
sophie: +1, will get templates by EOD.
omar: Pasted fallback matrix: https://redwood.internal/docs/fallback-matrix (read-only).
jules: Runbook draft uploaded to the shared drive at /ops/partner-sims/runbook-partner-99.md
kevin: Escalation template uploaded to /support/templates/escalation-timeline.md. I’ll be on the sim.
elaine: Great — see you Monday. :rocket:
